units.source_text: “……这个夏天，我收到了你的两三封信。

en.t: ... This summer, I received two or three letters from you.

units.source_text: 记得在第二封信里，你托我在东京寻个体面些的工作。

en.t: I remember that in your second letter, you asked me to find you a respectable position in Tokyo.

units.source_text: 看了信后，我很想帮你这个忙，

en.t: After reading your letter, I very much wanted to help you with this favor,

units.source_text: 至少打算给你回一封信，不然就太说不过去了。

en.t: or at least intended to write you a reply, since otherwise it would have been inexcusable.

units.source_text: 然而，坦白地说，对于你的请托我几乎不曾尽力。

en.t: However, to be frank, I made almost no effort at all regarding your request.

units.source_text: 你也知道，我交际面狭窄，

en.t: As you know, my circle of acquaintances is narrow,

units.source_text: 或者说，我过着遗世独立的孤寂生活更贴切，

en.t: or rather, it would be more accurate to say that I live a lonely life apart from the world,

units.source_text: 因此，即便我作出努力也是没有意义的。

en.t: and therefore even if I had made an effort, it would have meant nothing.

units.source_text: 然而，这并非关键所在。

en.t: But that is not the essential point.

units.source_text: 说句实话，当时，我正为如何处置自己而深陷痛苦之中，

en.t: To tell the truth, at that time I was sunk in anguish over what I should do with myself,

units.source_text: 就这样像个残留于世的木乃伊般地苟活下去，还是……

en.t: whether to go on living like a mummy left behind in the world, or...

units.source_text: 那时的我，每当想到‘还是’时，便不由得一阵哆嗦。

en.t: At that time, whenever I thought of that word 'or,' I could not help shuddering.

units.source_text: 我就如同飞奔到悬崖边，却愕然看见面前是深不见底的峡谷的人一般。

en.t: I was like someone who had run to the edge of a cliff, only to stare in shock at a bottomless ravine before him.

units.source_text: 我是个怯懦的人，和大多数怯懦的人一样，我感到痛苦不堪。

en.t: I was a coward, and like most cowards, I suffered terribly.

units.source_text: 很遗憾，毫不夸张地说，那时我心里，你这个人几乎是不存在的，

en.t: Regrettably, without exaggeration, at that time you scarcely existed in my mind,

units.source_text: 具体说来，你找工作之事、你的糊口之资，这些东西于我而言，都是毫无意义，怎样都无所谓的。

en.t: More specifically, your search for work and your means of livelihood were, to me, utterly meaningless things that did not matter either way.

units.source_text: 我哪里还顾得上考虑这些，

en.t: I was in no state to concern myself with such matters,

units.source_text: 把你的信往信袋里一插，我仍旧抱臂沉思。

en.t: and after slipping your letter into the letter holder, I went on sitting with my arms folded, lost in thought.

units.source_text: 家里多少有些财产的人，何至于刚一毕业，就为了谋求职位而惶惶不可终日呢？

en.t: Why should someone whose family had a certain amount of property become so frantic about finding a position the moment he graduated?

units.source_text: 我甚至怀着厌恶的心情，不屑地瞥了一眼远在家乡的你。

en.t: With a feeling almost of disgust, I even cast a contemptuous glance toward you far away in your hometown.

units.source_text: 我毫不掩饰地坦白这些，是为了说明本应给你回信，却没有回信的缘由。

en.t: I confess these things without hiding anything in order to explain why I should have answered you but did not.

units.source_text: 我不是为了激怒你，才说出这些冒犯的话。

en.t: I am not saying these offensive things in order to make you angry.

units.source_text: 我相信只要你能看完这封信，便会明白我的本意。

en.t: I believe that if you read this letter through to the end, you will understand my true intention.

units.source_text: 总之，原本我应该回封信，却没有那么做，所以愿在你面前，谢此怠慢之罪。

en.t: In any case, I should have written back but failed to do so, and so I wish to apologize to you for this negligence.
